content.text:
I submitted **index 8 (Pb 0.52 / Sb 0.48)** as the best composition. Its EQE was 0.0084%, which is very low in absolute terms, so this library has little photoactivity at 2.7 eV.

I chose index 8 first because it sits near Pb₂Sb₂O₇, a known lead antimonate with a band gap of about 2.5 eV, so it should absorb 2.7 eV light. The other two measurements came in lower on both sides:

| Index | Pb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0.76 (Pb-rich end) | −0.0012 (no response) |
| 8 | 0.52 | **0.0084** |
| 10 | 0.44 | 0.0001 |

That brackets the peak near Pb 0.5, but it rests on only three points. There are gaps I couldn't check:
- **Between the measured points:** index 9 (Pb 0.48) and indices 5–7 (Pb 0.56–0.63) were not measured. The fitted model had put index 6 slightly above index 10.
- **The Sb-rich end:** nothing below Pb 0.44 was measured, including the PbSb₂O₆ composition around Pb 0.33.
- **XRD:** I didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements, so the pyrochlore phase at index 8 is assumed from composition, not confirmed.
